source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The Makefile gets BINPATH and FINDPATH from MOZ_PKG_BINPATH, RESPATH from MOZ_PKG_RESPATH, and Darwin APPNAME from MOZ_MACBUNDLE_NAME. The selected manifest and package-compare target consume these defines and paths. This replaces local platform guesses with a shared configuration boundary, but the upstream definitions and generated package results were not inspected or executed. No Mac installer/build result is claimed.
title: Installer path defines now use the shared package variables
